prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a side impact at an intersection. The primary damage is to the driver-side front door, rear quarter panel and the adjacent sill, with a crushed door beam and cracked window glass. Most of what I observed lines up with the impact as described. The estimate has been reviewed against the bills, and nothing appears billed twice. Labor hours are consistent with the extent of the work. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record. Recommended plan: replace the door shell and quarter panel, repair the sill, install new glass, and refinish the affected panels to match.
